title: Environment
description: Variables your app reads at start. Sensitive values stay masked everywhere; revealing one asks you to confirm it's you and is recorded in the audit log.

sensitive.convertHint: Looks like a credential stored as plain text

add.suggestSecret: This name looks sensitive. Store it as a Secret so the value is encrypted at rest.
add.invalidKey: Use letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit
add.secretsOff: Secrets need a master key on the control plane

bulk.label: Variables as .env text, one KEY=value per line
bulk.hint: Masked values (••••••••) keep what is stored. Delete a line to remove a variable. Vault variables are edited in the table.

review.title: Review changes
review.description: Nothing is saved until you confirm. Sensitive values are never shown here.

scan.title: These values look like credentials
scan.description: Plain variables are visible to anyone who can read this app. Store them as Secrets so they stay encrypted.

redeploy.title: Redeploy needed
redeploy.description: The running container still has the old values. Restart the app to apply them.

inherited.title: Inherited variables
inherited.description: Set on the organization, project or environment. Override one to give this app its own value.

empty.title: No variables yet
empty.description: Add a variable or import a .env file. Values that look like credentials are masked automatically.

stepUp.title: Confirm it's you
stepUp.descriptionReveal: Revealing {{key}} on {{app}} is recorded in the audit log. You won't be asked again for {{minutes}} minutes.
stepUp.descriptionExport: Exporting every value of {{app}} is recorded in the audit log.
stepUp.descriptionManage: Making values visible or unlocking secrets on {{app}} needs a fresh confirmation.
stepUp.codeHint: Your account uses two-factor authentication, so enter the 6 digit code too.
stepUp.invalid: That password or code is not correct.
stepUp.locked: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
stepUp.noMethods: This account has no password or passkey to confirm with. Set a password in your account settings first.

policy.disabledTitle: Secret values are write-only on this server
policy.disabledBody: The server runs with APP_SECRET_REVEAL=disabled, so no one can read a stored value back. An administrator can set it to step_up to allow confirmed reveals.
policy.allowBody: APP_SECRET_REVEAL=allow lets anyone with read:sensitive see values without a password. Use step_up outside a single admin lab.
policy.writeOnlyTitle: Secrets are write-only for this app
policy.writeOnlyBody: The app owner locked reveals and full exports. You can still replace values.
policy.writeOnlyToggle: Secrets are write-only for this app
policy.writeOnlyToggleHint: Blocks every reveal and full export of this app's values. Turning it off asks you to confirm it's you.
policy.invalidBody: APP_SECRET_REVEAL has an unknown value, so reveals stay off until it is fixed.

convert.title: Convert {{key}} to a secret?
convert.description: The value moves into encrypted storage on the server and is removed from plain variables. It never passes through your browser.
convert.consequence: The running app keeps the old variable until you restart or redeploy.

errors.revealDisabled: Reveal is turned off on this server.

advanced.title: Preview, branch and environment comparison
advanced.description: Values used only by preview deployments and per-branch builds, plus a comparison with other environments.

bound.title: Connected resources
bound.description: Variables injected at container start from database links and bucket bindings. Read only here; change them on the database or bucket.
